back.en: Keeping the internal environment constant (temperature, glucose, water, pH, CO₂)
back.bm: Mengekalkan persekitaran dalam yang malar (suhu, glukosa, air, pH, CO₂)

back.en: A change from the set point triggers a response that reverses it
back.bm: Perubahan dari titik set mencetuskan gerak balas yang membalikkannya

back.en: Sweating, vasodilation, hairs lie flat, lower metabolic rate
back.bm: Berpeluh, vasodilatasi, rambut mendatar, kadar metabolisme menurun

back.en: Shivering, vasoconstriction, hairs stand up, more adrenaline/thyroxine
back.bm: Menggigil, vasokonstriksi, rambut tegak, lebih adrenalina/tiroksina

back.en: Insulin (β cells): lowers glucose. Glucagon (α cells): raises glucose
back.bm: Insulin (sel β): menurunkan glukosa. Glukagon (sel α): menaikkan glukosa

back.en: Glomerulus → Bowman's capsule under high pressure; proteins and cells stay in blood
back.bm: Glomerulus → kapsul Bowman di bawah tekanan tinggi; protein dan sel kekal dalam darah

back.en: From the pituitary; makes collecting ducts more permeable → more water reabsorbed → concentrated urine
back.bm: Dari pituitari; menjadikan duktus pengumpul lebih telap → lebih air diserap semula → air kencing pekat

back.en: Kidney stones, kidney failure (from diabetes, hypertension), urinary tract infection
back.bm: Batu karang, kegagalan ginjal (akibat diabetes, hipertensi), jangkitan saluran kencing

back.en: Blood passes a semi-permeable membrane; urea and excess salts diffuse into dialysis fluid
back.bm: Darah melalui membran separa telap; urea dan garam berlebihan meresap ke dalam cecair dialisis

back.en: Glucose rises → pancreas releases insulin → liver stores glucose as glycogen → level falls to normal
back.bm: Glukosa meningkat → pankreas merembeskan insulin → hati menyimpan glukosa sebagai glikogen → aras kembali normal

back.en: The functional unit of the kidney: glomerulus, Bowman's capsule, tubules, loop of Henle, collecting duct
back.bm: Unit fungsi ginjal: glomerulus, kapsul Bowman, tubul, gelung Henle, duktus pengumpul

back.en: All glucose and amino acids, most water and salts move from the tubules back into the blood
back.bm: Semua glukosa dan asid amino, kebanyakan air dan garam bergerak dari tubul kembali ke dalam darah

tip.en: Glucose in urine is a sign of diabetes mellitus.
tip.bm: Glukosa dalam air kencing ialah tanda diabetes melitus.

back.en: A healthy donor kidney replaces a failed one; needs a tissue match and lifelong immunosuppressants
back.bm: Ginjal penderma yang sihat menggantikan ginjal yang gagal; memerlukan padanan tisu dan ubat imunosupresan sepanjang hayat
